observations.description: Dishwasher leaves standing water after the cycle and displays no electrical or leak warning.

hazardAssessment.rationale: The supplied manual permits a powered-off visual filter inspection; no gas, mains electrical, structural, fire, contamination, height, or uncontrolled-water evidence is present.

hypotheses.statement: A visible filter obstruction may be contributing, but the cause remains unconfirmed.

steps.instruction: With appliance power isolated, remove and visually inspect the user-serviceable filter exactly as shown in the supplied manual.
prerequisites: No active leak, heat, burning odor, damaged wiring, or sharp broken component is present
stopConditions: The filter does not release with normal hand pressure
Damage, wiring, heat, odor, or uncontrolled water is observed
steps.restoration: Reinstall the filter in its documented locked position before restoring appliance power.
steps.verification: Run only the manual's short verification cycle and record whether drainage completes without a leak or warning.

unresolvedConditions: Whether the user-serviceable filter is obstructed

plan.serviceScope: Dishwasher drainage diagnosis only; no repair authorization.
plan.cancellationTerms: No fee when cancelled at least 24 hours before the appointment.
